title: Level Curves of a Circular Paraboloid
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe the level curves of z = x^2 + y^2 and find the radius of the level curve corresponding to c = 16.

steps.title: Set Function Equal to Constant c
steps.explanation: For c > 0, the equation describes a circle centered at the origin of radius sqrt(c).

steps.title: Evaluate for c = 16
steps.explanation: Substitute c = 16 to find the specific contour radius.
